quickAnswer: Allow 3 hours to 3 hours 30 minutes of pure driving from Kaş to Antalya Airport (AYT) via the 205 km D400 coastal route, plus 2 to 3 hours for terminal check-in. In July and August, add a 45-minute buffer for Kemer and Antalya city-approach traffic, or consider closer Dalaman Airport (DLM).

body.text: How many hours (3–3.5 hours) should you allow from Kaş to Antalya Airport?

Plan for 3 hours to 3 hours 30 minutes of driving from Kaş town center to [Fraport TAV Antalya Airport (AYT)](https://www.antalya-airport.aero/homepage) along the D400 via Demre, Finike, Kumluca, and Kemer. Add 2 hours before domestic departures and 2.5 to 3 hours before international flights, meaning you should leave Kaş 5.5 to 6.5 hours before takeoff.

That buffer is not excessive. The first half of the drive—from Kaş over the ridge to Demre and along the curving cliffs into Finike—is largely single-carriageway, where slow agricultural trucks from Kumluca's greenhouses restrict passing. Once you reach Antalya's western ring road, terminal selection also matters: AYT splits flights across Domestic, International Terminal 1, and International Terminal 2, so confirm your terminal on the [Antalya Airport international departures board](https://www.antalya-airport.aero/passengers-visitors/flight-info/international-departures) the evening before departure.
What coastal traffic delays occur in July–August near Kemer?

In July and August, resort coach changeovers and beachgoer traffic routinely slow the D400 between Tekirova, Kemer, Göynük, and the Konyaaltı tunnels entering Antalya. Delays of 25 to 45 minutes are common between 09:30 and 12:30 and again from 16:30 to 19:30, especially on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays.

Even minor fender-benders inside the coastal tunnels north of Beldibi can back up traffic for kilometers because there is no practical coastal bypass. When returning a rental car at AYT, build in another 20 minutes for refueling along the Serik/airport approach road and walking from the rental return lot to your departure terminal. Checking the [General Directorate of Highways (KGM) daily road bulletin](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteTr/YolDanisma/GunlukYolDurumuBulteni.aspx) before breakfast helps your driver gauge whether an earlier departure is wise.
Is Dalaman (DLM) or Antalya (AYT) better for Kaş departures?

[Dalaman Airport (DLM)](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Dalaman/AnaSayfa.aspx) is closer to Kaş—roughly 150 km and 2 hours 15 minutes to 2 hours 30 minutes away—making it faster and calmer for domestic Istanbul connections and UK/European summer charters. Antalya Airport (AYT) is roughly an hour farther, but offers far more year-round international nonstops and higher daily flight frequency.

body.text: If your flight departs before 10:00 AM, DLM is markedly less punishing—or consider spending your final night near Antalya's Kaleiçi old town rather than attempting a 03:30 AM departure from Kaş.
What stops (Olympos, Phaselis) work if you have a late flight?

For an evening departure from Antalya Airport (19:00 or later), Phaselis is the easiest and most rewarding en-route stop because it sits just 5 minutes off the D400 south of Kemer. Olympos works too, but its steep 11 km side road down to the valley floor adds extra driving and is best saved for travelers with at least four spare hours.
Use this late-flight departure checklist to keep your final day relaxed:

items: Phaselis (recommended): Allow 90 minutes to 2 hours at [Phaselis Archaeological Site](https://muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?SectionId=PHS01&DistId=PHS). Shaded pine paths connect three calm bays, Roman aqueduct arches, and a compact theater, with easy parking and changing facilities roughly 70 minutes from AYT.

Olympos & Çıralı: Turning down to [Olympos Archaeological Site](https://muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?SectionId=OLY01&DistId=OLY) takes 20 minutes each way off the main highway. Leave Kaş by 10:00 if you want a swim, lunch in Çıralı, and a stress-free 15:30 departure for an evening flight.
Ulupınar trout restaurants: Sitting directly beside the D400 between Olympos and Tekirova, these shaded riverside platforms offer a cool 60-minute lunch break with zero detour.
Pack a final-day dry bag: Keep swimsuits, towels, and fresh travel clothes in one accessible tote so you do not have to unpack checked luggage in a gravel parking lot.

faq.q: Is there a direct airport shuttle from Kaş to Antalya Airport?
faq.a: There is no direct public Havaş shuttle from Kaş to AYT. Public transport requires taking a regional bus from Kaş Otogar to Antalya Otogar (about 3.5 to 4 hours), then transferring by AntRay tram or taxi to the airport (another 45 to 60 minutes).

faq.q: Should I drive from Kaş to Antalya Airport in the dark?
faq.a: Avoid driving the Kaş–Finike stretch after dark if you are unfamiliar with the road. The mountain hairpins above Demre and coastal bends have limited lighting, occasional stray goats, and slow local vehicles.

faq.q: Which route from Kaş to Antalya is faster: coastal D400 or inland via Elmalı?
faq.a: The coastal D400 via Demre, Finike, and Kemer is generally faster and more direct to Antalya Airport. The inland Elmalı highland route is slightly longer and used mainly during winter coastal storms or major road closures.

faq.q: How early should I leave Kaş for a 15:00 international flight from AYT?
faq.a: In summer, depart Kaş no later than 08:30. That gives you 3.5 to 4 hours for the drive and Kemer traffic, arriving at your international terminal around 12:00 to 12:30 for bag drop and passport control.

faq.q: Can a private transfer wait while we visit Phaselis?
faq.a: Yes. Most private transfer drivers between Kaş and Antalya Airport can include a 2-hour wait at Phaselis for an agreed waiting fee, keeping your luggage locked inside the vehicle while you walk the ruins.

faq.q: Is Dalaman or Antalya cheaper for private transfers from Kaş?
faq.a: Transfers from Kaş to Dalaman Airport (DLM) are typically 20% to 30% less expensive than transfers to Antalya Airport (AYT) because the distance is about 55 km shorter and avoids urban Antalya traffic.
